conversations.content:
You are a helpful task planner.
First I will give you the task description and actions list you can take to finish the task, and your task is to plan a sequence of nodes which are subtasks to achieve the task. Each node of workflow is a subtask, and you can take actions to complete the subtask.
After you construct the plan, since some subtasks may not be dependent on each other, while others may have dependencies, please convert these nodes of subtasks into a topology diagram based on the task relevance in the workflow. The Graph should start with START node, and end with END node.
The total cost must not exceed the maximum cost.
Keep your output in foramt:
Node:
1.{subtask_1}
2.{subtask_2}
...
Edges:
(START,1)
...
(n,END))

Task: How to Clean a Jade Roller with a total cost under 15
The action list you can take: ['Take some lukewarm water, wash the brushes and let it dry.(cost: 1)
', 'Rinse the brush and towel dry it.(cost: 1)
', 'Place the roller on a soft towel to let it air dry.(cost: 1)
', 'Clean off massage oil with nail polish remover in the cotton pad.(cost: 5)
', 'Rub the jade piece with a dry cloth to remove excess soap.(cost: 2)
', 'Use a rubber cleaning stone to get rid of any remaining dirt.(cost: 8)
', 'Clean the heated curler using rubbing alcohol.(cost: 4)
', 'Gently scrub any gems, glass beads, or metal elements.(cost: 3)
', 'Heat your jade roller at 105 to 110 °F (41 to 43 °C) in your oven for powerful drying.(cost: 10)
', 'Dip a soft cleaning cloth into olive oil.(cost: 3)
']

Node:
1: Rub the jade piece with a dry cloth to remove excess soap.
2: Place the roller on a soft towel to let it air dry.
3: Heat your jade roller at 105 to 110 °F (41 to 43 °C) in your oven for powerful drying.
Edge: (START,1) (1,2) (2,3) (3,END)
